steps.note: A PINNED board, which every real one is. The update POST has to carry the pin the way /update reads it -- on the QUERY. It carried it in the body only, so the first POST came back 403, the worker's 403 branch latched the link dead, and a kid pressing UPDATE ONLINE got 'the console stopped answering' instantly on a board that was answering fine. Every other update test ran against an OPEN twin and could not see it.
Ask the console to check, through the same bridge Settings uses, and let the pump carry it.
